description: Angular standalone component for a data table page with filtering, sorting, pagination, and API integration.

classes.name: DataPage
classes.description: Angular component class managing data table with filtering, sorting, pagination, and API data fetching.

methods.name: onGlobalFilterChange
methods.description: Handles change in global filter input, updates query, and reloads data.

methods.name: setColumnFilter
methods.description: Sets filter for a specific column and reloads data.

methods.name: onLazyLoad
methods.description: Handles lazy loading event from PrimeNG table, updates query parameters, and fetches data.

methods.name: statusSeverity
methods.description: Returns severity level for status for display purposes.

methods.name: composeFilterQuery
methods.description: Constructs combined filter query string from global and column filters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches data page from API and updates component state.
